name: Kanto in Motion
description: Kanto in Motion multi-generation HD Pokemon presentation and battle overhaul. Supports Red/Blue/Yellow, Gold/Silver/Crystal, and FireRed/LeafGreen; v1.6.0 adds a slim-core HD asset manager, expanded Gen 2 Modern UI/new-game presentation, Dex Radar compatibility, Gen 1 native-fit battle backgrounds, and FR/LG fallback/stability improvements.
